post.originalText:
same prompt. four models. four completely different robots

gave four frontier models one job - build a 3D robot rolling through a summer forest. put all four side by side

the AI generation lottery report:

Opus 5.5 - $24 / 7 min
Fable 5.2 - $6 / 2 min
Kimi K3.1 - $58 / 15 min
GPT 6 Astra - $93 / 23 min

the priciest run cost about 15x more than the cheapest. took over 11x longer too

and the best result wasn't the most expensive one. Fable pulled off warm forest lighting and a clean render for six bucks in two minutes. GPT 6 Astra burned almost a hundred dollars and came back with Minecraft

when you pay for AI generation you're not buying quality. you're buying a lottery ticket

which panel would you pick?
